reason: The current sampled-softmax SASRec reaches macro validation HR@10 of 0.5137, but Electronics remains at 0.410 versus the baseline's 0.420; this motivates testing complementary history preferences without establishing the cause of the gap. Historical recency-weighting failures favor retaining uniform supervision and pooling without temporal decay. Modify model_design for the causal preference branch and training_evaluation for architecture metadata, predictor integration, and controlled validation.

plan.model_design: Extend SASRec with a learned preference projection and feature-wise fusion gate while preserving existing class names, constructor arguments, and forward(self, seq), ranking_loss(self, seq, pos, negative), and predict(self, seq, candidates) signatures. In forward, obtain raw self.item_emb(seq), explicitly mask padding, and compute each observed prefix mean using cumulative embedding sums divided by cumulative nonpadding counts clamped to at least one; pool only the supplied truncated window, without positional embeddings, recency decay, pos, or negative inputs. Project these means to hidden_units and apply LayerNorm to align their scale with the existing normalized sequence features x, then compute g = sigmoid(gate(concat(x, preference))) and fused = ((1 - g) * x + g * preference) * keep, initializing gate weights to zero and its bias to -2 so training initially favors SASRec. Return fused from forward so ranking_loss and predict automatically share the learned representation, retaining candidate embedding scoring and item_bias unchanged. Preserve the uniform losses.mean() reduction, positive-plus-64-negative cross-entropy, Transformer configuration, sampling, optimizer, and hyperparameters to isolate the architectural hypothesis and avoid repeating unsuccessful recency-weighted supervision.
plan.training_evaluation: Update train_one architecture metadata and PREDICTOR together with its writer in main so working/predict.py reconstructs the gated SASRec, strictly loads all branch parameters, and uses the existing pack_history and dataset_name routing for all four categories. Preserve existing function signatures and variable names, adding only optional trailing constructor configuration fields if needed and saving their actual values in meta; keep seed_all(42), preprocessing seed 0, supplied splits, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], AdamW settings, sampling, batch size, steps, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, patience, and checkpoint selection unchanged. Verify padding-safe prefix means, invariance of earlier-position features to later-item changes with dropout disabled, branch gradient flow, and validation-versus-generated-predictor score agreement after checkpoint reload. Evaluate with the unchanged fixed 200-user-per-category, 99-unique-negative, seed-42 protocol, selecting checkpoints by HR@10 with NDCG@10 breaking ties and comparing host macro HR@10 against 0.5137 alongside all category scores, especially Electronics against 0.410 and baseline 0.420. Retain single-GPU execution, existing runtime controls and the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget, trial-local artifacts, and host-only held-out inference without additional data, pretrained weights, hidden-test access, or evaluator changes.
